an4.235:1.7: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ?
an4.235:1.8: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, kāmesu micchācārī hoti, musāvādī hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti.
an4.235:1.9: Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ. 3.
an4.235:2.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ?
an4.235:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti . . . surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
an4.235:2.3: Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ. 4.
an4.235:3.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ?
an4.235:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco savyāpajjham pi avyāpajjham pi . . . pe . . . [232. 4]. Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ. 5.
an4.235:4.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhamasukkaṃ akaṇha-asukkavipākaṃ . . . saṃvattati?
an4.235:4.2: Tatra bhikkhave yam idaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ . . . pe . . . [232..] idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhamasukkaṃ akaṇha-asukkavipākaṃ kammaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.235:4.3: Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni. 6. Cattār'
